strategy.title: No plan: the only opening is one $6,000 audit for one transit authority, a third of the $18,000 target
strategy.why: The single opening is a one-off ADA bus-stop audit for one organisation (Tri-County Regional Transit Authority) at an evidenced $6,000 (award notice, 2026-11-10), fulfilled by Access Survey Partners at a written $2,400. Even if the authority agreed, one buyer buying once settles at most $6,000 inside 60 days, against an $18,000 target; one organisation is not a population of buyers, and its close rate is not established either.

alternatives.title: Sell the same audit to three buyers
alternatives.why: Rejected: only Tri-County is evidenced as a buyer at $6,000; no other transit authority, count of such authorities or their purchase cadence is on the record.

alternatives.title: Conditional pitch to Tri-County alone
alternatives.why: Rejected as a plan for this goal: even a measured yes carries $6,000 gross ($3,600 after the $2,400 subcontract), so the test could not decide the $18,000 target.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is correct. The only opening is a one-off audit for one organisation (Tri-County Regional Transit Authority) at an evidenced $6,000 (its own purchase order, so a real price this buyer pays). Even at a 100% close the held openings settle at most $6,000 gross ($3,600 after the $2,400 Access Survey Partners subcontract) against an $18,000 target; Brain's own check agrees (at most 6000). One organisation is not a population, and no further buyers are on the record, so the decisive gap - buyer volume beyond this single buyer - is correctly named, with a concrete research step and the target-relaxation alternative.
findings: Recomputed: 1 buyer x $6,000 = $6,000 max gross, 33% of $18,000; cost $2,400 < price, 30-day settlement fits 60 days - none of that rescues the shortfall.
Disagreement with Brain's MARKET_VOLUME basis is about goal coverage rather than the link for this one-off; it does not change the stance.

Worth checking when re-planning: the price fact is a purchase order issued 2026-11-10 while the buying signal is dated 2026-11-24 - if the PO was already awarded to another vendor, current demand for this specific audit may be gone.
CONVERSION is also unestablished (no close rate for this buyer); correctly listed as unknown, not assumed.
Owner hours (card 2h) are within an unstated owner-hours limit; no spend, inside the $0 exposure cap.
